szoveg_eredeti:
Last day to exhibit your breakthrough to 10,000+ tech leaders at Disrupt is on Oct 2. Book Exhibit Table Now.

Disrupt doors open Oct. 13. Get your pass and bring someone with you at 50% off. REGISTER NOW.

Four days. That’s all that stands between now and TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, when 10,000 founders, investors, and tech leaders descend on Moscone West in San Francisco on October 13-15. It’s also your final window to secure discounted online pricing.

Ticket savings of up to $100 will end when doors open on October 13 at 8 a.m. PT. Don’t forget to get a second pass of the same ticket types at 50% off. Or if you’ve been affected by a layoff, then grab your Expo+ Pass at just $75.

Different people come to Disrupt looking for different outcomes. For founders, the Expo Hall or the founder-investor exclusive Deal Flow Café could mean meeting an investor, customer, or potential partner. For investors, it could mean spotting a company before it breaks through. For department heads, it could mean finding a product that solves a genuine business problem. For technology companies, it’s a chance to see where the market is moving and who is moving with it.

Others will come for the ideas and expertise across 200+ sessions led by 250+ tech leaders across six stages, plus focused roundtables, breakout sessions, and Startup Battlefield 200 pitch sessions.

Whether your priority is finding a solution, meeting the right person, discovering your next investment, or hearing directly from the people shaping technology, you can build your time at Disrupt around the opportunities that matter to you.

TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is where the global startup ecosystem converges for three days of next-gen insights, meaningful connections, and a first look at what’s shaping the future of tech before it hits the headlines.

Whether you’re looking for your next investor, a co-founder, or insights into where the industry is headed, this is where you need to be.

Make one of your highest-ROI investments in Q4. Grab your pass now to save up to $100 before prices jump to door rates on October 13 at 8 a.m. PT. Plus, bring a co-founder, colleague, or industry peer for 50% off a second pass of the same ticket type. Recently laid off? Get in on the action with a special $75 Expo+ Pass.

cim: Négy nap múlva kezdődik a TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 konferencia
lead: A rendezvényen 10 000 alapító és befektető vesz részt San Franciscóban, a jegyeket már csak korlátozott ideig lehet kedvezményesen megvásárolni.
osszefoglalo:
A TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 technológiai konferencia október 13 és 15 között zajlik San Franciscóban. A rendezvényen több mint 250 előadó tart előadásokat hat színpadon, a fókuszban az induló vállalkozások és a technológiai trendek állnak.

A jegyárak október 13-án reggel emelkednek, addig a résztvevők akár **100 dollárt** is megtakaríthatnak a vásárláson. A szervezők emellett 50 százalékos kedvezményt biztosítanak a második azonos típusú jegyre.
miert_szamit: A rendezvény elsősorban a nemzetközi kapcsolatépítésről szól, de közvetlen gyakorlati haszna nincs a mindennapi magyar marketinges munkában, mivel **fizikai jelenlétet igényel** San Franciscóban.
